statement: theorem proximal_one_step_extended (f : E → EReal) (V : Set E) (hV : Convex ℝ V) (hf : BanditRL.OnlineConvex.SourceProper f) (hs : ∀ z ∈ V, (BanditRL.OnlineConvex.SourceSubdifferential f z).Nonempty) (ψ : E → ℝ) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) (x p : E) (hp : p ∈ V) (hdx : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ x) (hdp : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ p) (hmin : IsMinOn (fun z => f z + ((η⁻¹ * divergence ψ z x : ℝ) : EReal)) V p) : ∀ u ∈ V, η * ((f p).toReal - (f u).toReal) ≤ divergence ψ u x - divergence ψ u p - divergence ψ p x
